newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Accom raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Accom raised to buy.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said its analyst Doug van Dorsten raised his bid on shares of Accom Inc to buy from hold after the company reported a fiscal second quarter loss of $0.04 a share versus expectations of a loss of $0.06 a share.
-- In addition to boosting the rating, van Dorsten raised his 1997 EPS estimate to a loss $0.09 from a loss $0.10.

-- In a statement, van Dorsten also said the company's new products are beginning to ship into a video software industry that is improving, and he noted the company's stock, currently around 1-3/4, is relatively inexpensive.
